cues: On a quiet lane, a rider checks tire pressure before setting out for the morning commute.
When a chain slips between gears, a roadside repair can restore smooth pedaling.
At the trailhead, knobby tires offer grip on gravel while narrow tires favor paved roads.
A locked frame and front wheel discourage theft outside a crowded train station.
During a long climb, low gearing lets the rider keep turning the pedals steadily.
A child practices balance in an empty park before learning to steer through gentle turns.
After rain, wet rims may reduce stopping power, so riders brake early at intersections.
In a crowded workshop, a mechanic trues a wobbling wheel by adjusting its spokes.
